positions.rationale: Source AR «حي محيرس، المبرز» (governs) / EN «Muhairis district, Al-Mubarraz». Phrasing follows the binding sibling ev.wafrah-winter.place «محلہ الوفرہ، ہفوف کے جنوبی حصے میں»: district generic «محلہ» BEFORE the name (N73 point 1: «محلہ» stands before its name; termbase الوفرہ note), then «،», then the town. The neighbour binds phrasing not substance: the source has no 'south part', so the town stands bare as the source gives it, as in the sibling place rows «تاریخی قصر ابراہیم، ہفوف» and «تاریخی سوق القیصریہ، ہفوف». Order is the source's (district, town), as N30 keeps for a line whose source names no larger place first; N45 likewise writes the district word once. Names: «المبرز» verbatim from its termbase entry (P1: article kept; masculine; no 'city' word since neither source has it); «محیرس» is the name element of the approved title «قصر محیرس» (termbase entry, src/content/attractions/muhairis.md title_ur), built from the Arabic spelling. «محیرس» is not a common Urdu word, so no «نامی» is owed (N73 point 2 is for homographs such as «الطرف»; cf. N352/N357). Letterforms checked by code point: ی U+06CC, ہ U+06C1, no U+064A/U+0643/U+0629/U+0647/U+0649/U+0623/U+0625/U+06C3 (P11, P17). Plain text, one line, U+0020 only, no final stop in a card value (P26). Nothing added: no street, building number, direction or description of the village.

alternatives.why_not: Adds a postposition the sibling's bare-town pattern and the other place rows do not carry when no relative position is given; the card label already says 'location'.
P20's larger-place-first order binds area_ur on attraction pages; the binding precedent for event place rows (wafrah-winter) keeps district first, and the Arabic source order is district, town.
«نامی» is the line's cure for a name readable as a common word (N73 (2), N352, N357); «محیرس» is not one, and the Wafrah sibling, the precedent for a district, uses «محلہ X».

notes: Risk for stage 6: the blind reader may link «محیرس» to the palace page «قصر محیرس» (same name element, the palace lies in north Al-Mubarraz per its approved body). That is the source's fact (district named after the same place), not a defect; no gloss is added. Termbase: no new key needed — «محیرس» as a bare district name has no entry of its own; it is the name element of «قصر محیرس» (pending, ur.wikipedia 0 pages for «محیرس»). Stage 4/7 may decide whether to add a district key «محلہ محیرس» (masculine by «محلہ», like الوفرہ).
